content.text: Excellent! I found the issue! On line 12 of `/testbed/django/db/models/utils.py`, when a string model reference is passed (like "DJ_RegLogin.Category"), it's split into `app_label` and `model_name`, but then `model_name.lower()` is called, NOT `app_label.lower()`. The problem is that on line 14, when a model instance is passed, it uses `model._meta.app_label` which is the actual app label from the app config.
